from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashPosition(BaseModel):
    """Extracted cash and cash equivalents figure from a single financial statement."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported in the document")
    fiscal_year: str | None = Field(description="The fiscal year covered by the report, e.g. '2023'")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label of the line item containing the value, e.g. 'Cash and cash equivalents'")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the cash figure")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale or unit of the amount, e.g. 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars'")
    report_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The specific date the report is as of, e.g. 'December 31, 2023'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_positions: list[CashPosition]
